Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jose Alvarado?

Jose Alvarado is 28 years old.

Where was Jose Alvarado born?

Jose Alvarado was born in Brooklyn, New York.

When was Jose Alvarado born?

Jose Alvarado was born on April 12, 1998.

How tall is Jose Alvarado?

Jose Alvarado is 6-0 (183 cm) tall.

How much does Jose Alvarado weigh?

Jose Alvarado weighs 179 lbs (81 kg).

What position does Jose Alvarado play?

Point Guard.

What is Jose Alvarado's net worth?

Jose Alvarado has made at least $11,388,212 playing professional basketball.

How much does Jose Alvarado make?

Jose Alvarado made $4,500,000 in 2026.

What is Jose Alvarado's Instagram account?

Jose Alvarado is on Instagram at realrytejose.

What schools did Jose Alvarado attend?

Jose Alvarado attended Christ the King in Queens, New York and Georgia Tech.

What are Jose Alvarado's nicknames?

Grand Theft Alvarado, GTA are nicknames for Jose Alvarado.
